instance_ids: 0-based specified reference instances; actual history is never completed from their normative order
event_order: unique ordered list of all actually detected instances only when the ledger confirms it; null when uncertainty remains; detection omissions are still possible
possible_onset_interval: (left,right] in observation indices; adjacent (a,b] and (b,c] can be ordered; null left means no reliable initial lower bound
first_detection_interval: the observation interval when presence first created this current record; separate from possible onset and confirmation
confirmation_interval: when sufficient evidence confirmed the current event hypothesis; null for candidate/ambiguous
evidence_sources: observed M1 presence/start and pooled B change values with their times; correlated scores, not independent probabilities
confirmed_precedence: only pairs with confirmed identity and strictly separated possible onset intervals
unresolved_order_groups: maximal sets of mutually unresolved relations; interval-overlap uncertainty need not be transitive
physical_irrecoverability: not established by learned detections; an inferred merged interval does not itself prove physically lost observations
audit: candidate creation, explicit rejection, confirmation and conflicts; earlier returned snapshots are immutable; confirmed events are not silently reordered
geometry_state: 0 absent / 1 partial / 2 full, fixed M1 prediction, scored independently
progress: raw continuous fixed M1 prediction; disagreement with geometry class is reported
observation_confidence: deterministic evidence flag, not calibrated answer correctness
decision: unchanged T6 rule D using class-derived completion and the predicted history
scope: T7 candidate interface only. Current onset, partial-order and progress failures prevent trusted H2 use.
